# Sly Academy

> Free, accessible exam preparation platform offering comprehensive study guides, interactive tools, and past papers for AP, IB, SAT, and ACT exams.

Sly Academy provides free educational resources designed to democratize test preparation across multiple standardized exams. The platform combines traditional study materials with interactive tools like score calculators, graphing calculators, and periodic tables to support student learning across STEM and humanities subjects.

## Key Topics

- AP Exam Prep
- Study Guides
- AP Physics (1, 2, C: Mechanics, C: E&M)
- AP Chemistry
- Kinematics
- SAT
- ACT
- IB
- Calculus-based Physics
- Algebra-based Physics
- Atomic Structure
- Course Notes
- Test Preparation
- Interactive Tools
- Periodic Table

## Core Platform & Tools

- [Free Study Guides, Past Papers & Exam Tips – Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com): Homepage: free study guides, past papers, exam tips for AP, IB, SAT, GCSE
- [About Us - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/about-us): Sly Academy mission: free, accessible learning for SAT, ACT, AP, IB exams
- [AP Score Calculator Hub 2026](https://slyacademy.com/ap-score-calculator): Free AP Score Calculator Hub for predicting exam scores across all subjects
- [The Periodic Table - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/the-periodic-table): Interactive periodic table with detailed element information and properties
- [Graphing Calculator - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/slyacademy-graphing-calculator): SlyAcademy 2D Graphing Calculator for visualizing mathematical functions

## AP Science Study Guides

- [AP Subjects - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/study-guides/ap-subjects): Comprehensive AP study guides covering Math, Science, History, and more
- [AP Chemistry – Notes And Study Guides - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/ap-chemistry-notes-and-study-guides): AP Chemistry study guide: atomic structure, molar mass, periodic trends
- [AP Physics 1 – Notes And Study Guides - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/ap-physics-1-notes-and-study-guides): AP Physics 1 study guide covering kinematics, dynamics, algebra-based physics
- [AP Physics 2 – Notes And Study Guides - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/ap-physics-2-notes-and-study-guides): AP Physics 2 study guide: fluids, thermodynamics, algebra-based physics
- [AP Physics C: Mechanics – Notes And Study Guides - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/ap-physics-c-mechanics-notes-and-study-guides): AP Physics C Mechanics: calculus-based kinematics and Newton's Laws
- [AP Physics C: E&M – Notes And Study Guides - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/ap-physics-c-em-notes-and-study-guides): AP Physics C E&M study guide: Coulomb's Law, Gauss's Law, electromagnetism

## AP Humanities & Social Sciences

- [AP World History: Modern – Notes And Study Guides - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/ap-world-history-modern-notes-and-study-guides): AP World History Modern study guide covering global civilizations 1200+
- [AP European History - Notes And Study Guides - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/ap-european-history-notes-and-study-guides): AP European History: Renaissance, Age of Exploration to modern times
- [AP Psychology (2025) – Notes And Study Guides - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/ap-psychology-2025-notes-and-study-guides): AP Psychology 2025 study guide: biological bases, cognition, behavior units
- [AP English Language – Notes And Study Guides](https://slyacademy.com/ap-english-language-notes-and-study-guides): AP English Language guide: rhetorical analysis, argumentation, composition

## AP Computer Science

- [AP Computer Science A – Notes And Study Guides - Sly Academy](https://slyacademy.com/ap-computer-science-a-notes-and-study-guides): AP Computer Science A guide: Java programming, OOP, primitive types
- [AP Computer Science Principles – Notes And Study Guides](https://slyacademy.com/ap-computer-science-principles-notes-and-study-guides): AP Computer Science Principles: binary, data representation, programming
